# Joshua Heagle

> Joshua Evan Heagle (most people call him Evan) is a full-stack engineer in the Greater Toronto Area. He works on
> architecture, refactoring and shared tooling, directs AI coding agents through real work, and maintains a family of
> open-source TypeScript libraries that build on each other. Open to full-time roles and contracts.

This site is static HTML. Every page reads fine without JavaScript, apart from the live demos on /projects/.

## About

- [Home](https://joshuaheagle.com/): who he is, what he's doing now, how he works, selected work, experience and contact
- [Resume (PDF)](https://joshuaheagle.com/assets/documents/Joshua_Heagle_Resume.pdf): the full work history
- [Blog](https://joshuaheagle.com/blog/): writing on fitness, gardening, building things and what he learns along the way ([RSS](https://joshuaheagle.com/blog/feed.xml))
- [Books](https://joshuaheagle.com/books/): what he has been reading since January 2025, with covers, dates, formats and notes, including the ones he didn't finish

Work history in brief: Full-Stack Engineer at BIC (formerly Inkbox), Toronto, April 2021 to present, now on BIC's
Global Supply Chain team; Software Developer II at Benevity, Toronto, 2017 to 2021; earlier at BID13, Techcom, 3conx and
Jackpine (2013 to 2017). Computer Engineering Technology, Computer Science, Algonquin College (2010 to 2013). Main
stack: PHP/Laravel, TypeScript and JavaScript, Node.

Contact: joshuaheagle@gmail.com, [LinkedIn](https://ca.linkedin.com/in/joshuaheagle), [GitHub](https://github.com/jheagle).

## Projects

All of them, with live demos of the ones that run in a browser: [Projects](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/).
Each project page links its generated API documentation at `<page>docs/`.

### The libraries (published on npm)

- [Sí, funciona](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/si-funciona/): dependency-light, fully typed general-purpose utility functions (npm `si-funciona`, [source](https://github.com/jheagle/si-funciona))
- [Collect your stuff (and go)!](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/collect-your-stuff/): classic collection types, such as queues, stacks and linked lists, fully typed (npm `collect-your-stuff`, [source](https://github.com/jheagle/collect-your-stuff))
- [json-fs-query](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/json-fs-query/): a query engine that treats a folder of JSON files as a database, with a small SQL-like language; reads also work in the browser (npm `json-fs-query`, [source](https://github.com/jheagle/json-fs-query))
- [Pseudo DOM](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/pseudo-dom/): a mock of the browser DOM for tests in Node, with real CSS selector matching (npm `pseudo-dom`, [source](https://github.com/jheagle/pseudo-dom))
- [Title Switcher](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/title-switcher/): the typing effect that cycles through titles, as on this site's homepage (npm `title-switcher`, [source](https://github.com/jheagle/title-switcher))
- [Test Filesystem](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/test-filesystem/): set up and tear down a temporary directory for filesystem tests (npm `test-filesystem`, [source](https://github.com/jheagle/test-filesystem))

### The rendering stack and the game that proves it

- [treeloom](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/treeloom/) (formerly JSON DOM): a from-scratch virtual-DOM framework with a composable trait system, including a render-only mode that forwards events to a server
- [treeloom-matrix](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/treeloom-matrix/) (formerly Matrix DOM): grid and matrix geometry on top of treeloom, used by Cloakfall's boards and by this site's project grid
- [treeloom-components](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/treeloom-components/): ready-made treeloom components (base HTML element factories, a typeahead, a clearable input), used by Quizzes and this site's project grid
- [Cloakfall](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/cloakfall/) (formerly Battleship): a multiplayer, hidden-fleet game built on the whole stack ([play it](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/cloakfall/play.html), [source](https://github.com/jheagle/cloakfall))

### Build tooling

- [js-build-tools](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/js-build-tools/): the shared Gulp-based build, test and documentation pipeline used across these packages (npm `js-build-tools`, [source](https://github.com/jheagle/js-build-tools))
- [Common Exports](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/common-exports/): converts ES modules to CommonJS for dual-format builds (npm `common-exports`, [source](https://github.com/jheagle/common-exports))

### Apps

- [Quizzes](https://joshuaheagle.com/quizzes/): dynamic forms described as treeloom data, a form.io alternative
- [Workout Planner](https://joshuaheagle.com/projects/workout-planner/): an early, evolving idea for workout tracking ([source](https://github.com/jheagle/workout-planner))
